statement: Given n integers, output their maximum. The first line contains n (1 <= n <= 8). The second line contains n integers in [-100,100]. Output the maximum integer.
source:
n = int(input())
values = list(map(int, input().split()))
best = 0
for value in values:
    best = max(best, value)
print(best)
